scope_note: Unproven tools/strict lexical style heuristics and style scanners that duplicate compiler/lint.ouro. Proven style (duplicate import, `;;`, `<-`/let!, typed Cons/Nil spans, alias/open) and language hole/unbound/unused/shadow remain.

rules.reason: Lexical TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX grep without proof. The scanner self-hits on its own search literals. Placeholder tracking is an issue/RFC, not a source-text deny.
Accessor-name guess: `Type_field` plus `| MkType` match text does not prove a record projection replacement.
Nested-application depth is a parenthesis count, not a data-flow or pipe-equivalence proof.
Wrapper guess: `def name := other;` does not prove a pointless alias or a safe inline.
Module size is a nonblank-line count, not a mixed-responsibility or split proof.
Function size is a line-span count, not a complexity or extract-helper proof.
Public-docs guess: nearby `@doc`/`docs/` text does not prove API documentation or a required export contract.
Panic/ICE grep without diagnostic-handling proof. The scanner self-hits on its own search literals.
Style shadow scanner duplicates language lint. compiler/lint.ouro owns WShadow as OURO-LINT004.
Style unused-binder scanner duplicates language lint. compiler/lint.ouro owns WUnused as OURO-LINT003.
